## Reconciliation sweep
n8n replacement for the "runs once at process start" reconciliation both poll loops did in local-agent/agent.mjs. No equivalent "start" moment exists in an always-on n8n deployment, so this runs on a 5-10 minute Schedule Trigger instead -- strictly safer than once-at-startup (checked far more often) and also covers a new n8n-specific failure mode (a workflow execution erroring mid-item with no process-restart to fall back on).

Both branches are independent un-stick sweeps (status=processing stuck past a claimed_at window -> back to pending) -- neither depends on the other's output, so they run as two branches off one trigger rather than chained (chaining risks item-multiplication if either RPC ever returns more than one stale row).

INACTIVE / BUILD-ONLY (n8n migration Stage 0). The "Postgres (n8n pipeline)" credential is a placeholder -- see n8n/README.md. This workflow must never be activated until local-agent/agent.mjs's own reconciliation call is retired alongside it.
